title: 第13章 哪里冒出来的神秘强者第14章 绝世强者竟是你爹
content_zh:
“兄弟们快看，那有两个极品！”
几个红衣大汉，眼睛喷吐着火焰，往许小凡，张化龙这边走了过来。
张化龙扫视一圈后表情一僵，语速极快道：
“许兄他刚刚是不是说两个极品？”
许小凡很肯定的点头，“没错张兄。”
张化龙继续道：“这一个极品肯定是你，那另外一个极品...”
许小凡认真打量了几眼张化龙，随即道：
“众口难调，每个人的口味不一样，比如有人喜欢女的，有人喜欢男的，有人喜欢瘦的，自然也有人喜欢胖的...”
张化龙面色忽然惨白下来。
见状许小凡有些疑惑道：
“张兄，你背景不是很硬吗，怎么会担心这个？”
张化龙惨笑一声，“背景是硬，但有些时候，难免一些人会失去理智，而不管不顾...”
许小凡看了几个越来越近的红衣大汉，努了努嘴，“你是指他们？”
张化龙刚刚想点头，却突然感觉屁股被拍了一下，顿时吓的浑身止不住打颤。
但他还是嘴硬道：“操，谁敢动老子，家父张二牛！”
身后，一个壮硕的红衣络腮胡大汉嘿嘿笑着道：“张二牛？你是帝都张家的？”
张化龙神色傲然，“没错！”
那络腮胡大汉则道：
“那又怎么样？
我们又不害你性命。

你觉得你爹会为了这种事，来找我们红衣会拼命吗？”
说罢，络腮胡大汉对身边另几人道：
“这极品，容我先品尝。
那个瘦不拉几的给你们，随便怎么玩。
死了也没事。”
其余几人笑呵呵的点头，便朝淫笑着朝着许小凡走去。
“小子，别动，否则杀了你！”
许小凡只觉得浑身一阵恶寒，恨不得将几人碎尸万段。
但为了系统奖励，他还是暂时忍了下来，冲着张化龙道：“快跑胖子！”
虽然被人喊胖子很不舒服，但张化龙还是当机立断跟着许小凡一块跑。
二人现在只想冲入人群，躲藏起来，离这些恶心的禽兽远一点...
络腮胡大汉搓搓手，淫笑着道：“你别说，还挺有情趣...”
接着，带着手底下几个人追了过去！
......
另一边，船舱内。
“唉，这里面好像还有人？”
content_en:
"Brothers, look, there are two top quality ones!"
Several big men in red clothes, with eyes spitting out flames, walked over to Xu Xiaofan and Zhang Hualong.
After Zhang Hualong glanced around, his expression froze and he spoke very quickly:
"Brother Xu, did he just say two top quality ones?"
Xu Xiaofan nodded firmly, "That's right, Brother Zhang."
Zhang Hualong continued: "This one is definitely you, the other one is definitely you..."
Xu Xiaofan looked at Zhang Hualong carefully for a few times and then said:
"It's hard to agree with everyone. Everyone has different tastes. For example, some people like women, some people like men, some people like thin people, and naturally some people like fat people..."
Zhang Hualong's face suddenly turned pale.
Seeing this, Xu Xiaofan was a little confused and said:
"Brother Zhang, don't you have a strong background? Why are you worried about this?"
Zhang Hualong laughed miserably, "The background is tough, but sometimes, it is inevitable that some people will lose their minds and ignore it..."
Xu Xiaofan looked at several big men in red who were getting closer and closer, and pursed his lips, "You mean them?"
Zhang Hualong was about to nod when he suddenly felt his butt being slapped, and he was so frightened that he couldn't stop trembling all over.
But he still said stubbornly: "Fuck, who dares to touch me, my father Zhang Erniu!"
Behind him, a sturdy man in red with a beard and a beard chuckled and said, "Zhang Erniu? Are you from the Zhang family in the imperial capital?"
Zhang Hualong looked proud, "That's right!"
The bearded man said:
"So what?
We won't take your life.
Do you think your father would come to us, Hongyi, to fight for something like this? "
After saying that, the bearded man said to the others around him:
"This is the best, let me taste it first.
I'll give you the skinny guy, you can play with him as you like.
It's okay to die. "
The other people nodded with smiles and walked towards Xu Xiaofan with lewd smiles.
"Boy, don't move, or I'll kill you!"
Xu Xiaofan felt a chill all over his body and wished he could cut these people into pieces.
But for the sake of system rewards, he endured it temporarily and said to Zhang Hualong: "Run away, fat man!"
Although it was uncomfortable to be called fat, Zhang Hualong still made the decision and ran with Xu Xiaofan.
The two of them just want to rush into the crowd, hide, and stay away from these disgusting beasts...
The bearded man rubbed his hands and said with a lewd smile: "Don't tell me, it's quite interesting..."
Then, he led a few of his men in pursuit!
...
On the other side, inside the cabin.
"Hey, there seems to be someone else here?"
